name: CoinPayments
description: CoinPayments Invoice API v2 with signed HMAC webhooks and full admin configuration.
author: XBoard Team

enabled.label: Enable CoinPayments
enabled.description: Only display CoinPayments after all required connection settings are configured.

display_name.label: Display name
display_name.description: The name customers see when choosing this payment method.

coinpayments_client_id.label: Integration Client ID
coinpayments_client_id.description: The Client ID from your CoinPayments API integration.

coinpayments_client_secret.label: Integration Client Secret
coinpayments_client_secret.placeholder: Leave blank to keep the current saved value.
coinpayments_client_secret.description: Used to sign HMAC-SHA256 requests. Keep it secret; leave blank while editing to preserve the saved value.

coinpayments_invoice_currency_id.label: Invoice currency ID
coinpayments_invoice_currency_id.description: The CoinPayments NEW currency ID used to create invoices and verify webhooks, for example 5057 for USD on Instance A.

coinpayments_payment_currency.label: Preferred payment currency ID
coinpayments_payment_currency.description: Optional CoinPayments NEW currency ID (for example 4:0x... for a token); leave blank to let customers choose.

coinpayments_cny_invoice_rate.label: CNY-to-invoice exchange rate
coinpayments_cny_invoice_rate.description: How many invoice-currency units equal one CNY.

coinpayments_api_base.label: API base URL
coinpayments_api_base.description: Keep the default unless CoinPayments provides a different endpoint.

coinpayments_webhook_url.label: Exact webhook URL
coinpayments_webhook_url.description: The exact public callback URL; configure it when using Cloudflare or a reverse proxy.

coinpayments_webhook_max_age.label: Webhook validity window (seconds)
coinpayments_webhook_max_age.description: Webhook replay-protection window; 300 seconds is recommended.
